name: phase2_refusals_by_code
description: Phase 2 cutover: one count per typed refusal written by a Phase 2 financial callable, labelled with its refusal code only (a stable string from functions/src/lib/errors.js - never a uid, an id or a figure). For dashboards and verification; NO alert reads it, so ordinary business refusals never page.
filter: resource.type="cloud_run_revision" AND resource.labels.location="australia-southeast1" AND resource.labels.service_name=("createvariation" OR "updatevariationdraft" OR "approvevariation" OR "applyvariationcommitment" OR "progressclaimoperation" OR "supplierinvoiceoperation" OR "suppliersettlementoperation" OR "postclientrefund" OR "voidclientrefund" OR "postclientreceiptapplication" OR "voidclientreceiptapplication" OR "voidclientinvoice" OR "contractvalueoperation" OR "estimateoperation" OR "postclientcreditnote" OR "voidclientcreditnote" OR "postclientretentionrelease" OR "voidclientretentionrelease" OR "postclientreceipt" OR "voidclientreceipt" OR "transferboqtobudget" OR "approvefinalaccount") AND log_id("run.googleapis.com/stdout") AND jsonPayload.message=("variation call refused" OR "supplier-finance call refused" OR "client finance call refused" OR "contract-value call refused" OR "estimate call refused" OR "boq transfer call refused" OR "final account call refused")
